segments.name: Operating dry bulk vessels
segments.description: Operates a fleet of dry bulk vessels, chartering them to customers under time and voyage charters and contracts of affreightment.
segments.evidence: the Company has determined that it operates under one reportable segment, that of operating dry bulk vessels.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company charter hire for transporting dry bulk cargo on its owned and chartered-in vessels under time charters, voyage charters and COAs.
revenueModel.evidence: One of our principal objectives is to acquire and charter-in additional vessels in conjunction with entering into additional time or voyage charters and COAs for these vessels.

changes.text: In 2025, as part of the realignment of the CBI business, the company transferred the majority of the operating platform trading book to a third party.
changes.evidence: For example, in September 2025, as part of the realignment of our CBI business, we transferred the majority of the operating platform trading book to a third party.

changes.text: The CBI dry bulk operating platform commenced operations in the fourth quarter of 2022.
changes.evidence: The CBI business commenced operations in the fourth quarter of 2022.
